name: DontStarveTogether
description: This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install Don't Starve Together and run it. ATTENTION: After the first complete startup (you can see it in the log) copy your 'cluster_token.txt' in the 'token/Cluster_1' folder and restart the container. First Startup can take very long since it downloads the gameserver files! Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available. You can also run multiple servers with only one SteamCMD directory!

paths.name: Token
paths.description: Put your created 'cluster_token.txt' in the 'Cluster_1' subfolder.

variables.name: GAME_ID
variables.description: The GAME_ID that the container download at startup. (https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List)

variables.name: Steam-Username
variables.description: Your Steam username goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

variables.name: Validate Installation
variables.description: Set the Variable to 'true' if you want to validate the installation otherwise leave it blank.

variables.name: Steam-Password
variables.description: Your Steam password goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

variables.name: Caves
variables.description: Delete 'true' if you don't want Caves on your Server.

variables.name: Force 64bit mode
variables.description: Set to true if you want to run the game in 64bit mode or leave empty to run it in 32bit mode.
